traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Cercidiphyllaceae: leaves alternate or opposite; leaves simple; margins crenate or serrate; veins palmate; leaves deciduous; stipules present; plants dioecious; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in racemes or in heads; perianth absent; fruit follicle; stamens 8 to 13; carpels 1. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
